comment: botl.c eval_notify_windowport_field() (1590) and status_eval_next_unhilite(). A debug-mode Wizard wishes for 50000 gold pieces, which makes her Burdened, then drops them: the change to an empty carrying-capacity val selects the temporary rule. When hilite_reset_needed() resets the field, its val is empty and chg is 0, so get_hilite() is not asked, the temporary rule stays, and the timer is stamped again every statushilites:2 turns while she searches. Seed, clock, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
